source: ESPN public injury report and game summaries

injuries.name: Dejounte Murray
injuries.short_comment: Murray (ankle) is out for Friday's game against Memphis.
injuries.long_comment: This was the expectation after the star guard requested a trade from the Pelicans earlier Friday. Given his standing with the club, Murray can be tentatively considered doubtful for future contests while New Orleans tries to find him another home.

injuries.name: Zion Williamson
injuries.short_comment: Williamson (thigh) is probable for Monday's game against Phoenix.
injuries.long_comment: Williamson sat out Saturday's 114-91 loss to San Antonio due to a left thigh contusion, but it sounds like he's trending in the right direction for Monday. His return would likely shift Derik Queen back to the bench.

injuries.name: Trey Murphy III
injuries.short_comment: Murphy (knees) is listed as probable for Monday's game against the Suns.
injuries.long_comment: Murphy has missed seven of New Orleans' past eight games due to bilateral patellar tendinopathy, though he's expected to suit up Monday. The 26-year-old swingman logged 29 minutes off the bench in Friday's loss to the Thunder, marking his return after a six-game stint on the inactive list. He could remain restricted if he's cleared to play Monday.

injuries.name: Trendon Watford
injuries.short_comment: Watford (ankle) is out for Saturday's game against the Spurs.
injuries.long_comment: Watford can be considered week-to-week at this point until the Pelicans offer an update on his recovery. He hasn't played since Nov. 8 and is averaging just 7.2 points and 3.5 boards per game in his six appearances off the bench.

injuries.name: Bryce McGowens
injuries.short_comment: McGowens (elbow) is listed as probable for Monday's game against Phoenix.
injuries.long_comment: McGowens has missed the Pelicans' last six games due to a left elbow infection, but it's an encouraging sign to see him listed as probable to return Monday. In seven regular-season outings, he's averaged 3.7 points and 1.1 steals in 10.6 minutes per game.

injuries.name: Bennedict Mathurin
injuries.short_comment: Mathurin (foot) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Thunder.
injuries.long_comment: Mathurin will miss a fourth straight contest due to plantar fasciitis in his left foot, which tends to be a lingering injury. Jordan Poole should remain in the backcourt rotation for the undermanned Pelicans moving forward, while Mathurin can be deemed week-to-week.

injuries.name: Mark Williams
injuries.short_comment: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
injuries.long_comment: This is a tough blow for the center with training camp right around the corner. With his status for Opening Night in jeopardy, this will put a lot of eyes on Oso Ighodaro and Khaman Maluach, with the latter already drawing buzz during the Summer League. More clarity on Williams' timeline should be known in the coming weeks.

injuries.name: Ryan Dunn
injuries.short_comment: Dunn (quadriceps) is listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Pelicans.
injuries.long_comment: Dunn exited Friday's win over Utah early due to right quad soreness, and despite practicing in full Sunday, he's still questionable to suit up versus New Orleans.
